name: Stok & Kedaluwarsa
description: Fase 1: stok per gudang/PT dari snapshot Odoo (per jam), lot kedaluwarsa <= 7 hari, stok di bawah titik pesan ulang (on-hand vs min orderpoint). Sumber: view efn_dwh.v_stock_*.

cards.name: Nilai stok saat ini
cards.description: Qty x harga pokok (standard_price) per PT.
cards.sql: SELECT sum(stock_value) AS nilai_stok FROM efn_dwh.v_stock_current WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Lot kedaluwarsa <= 7 hari
cards.description: Termasuk lot yang sudah lewat tanggal kedaluwarsa dan masih ada stok.
cards.sql: SELECT count() AS lot_kedaluwarsa_7_hari FROM efn_dwh.v_stock_expiring WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Produk di bawah titik pesan ulang
cards.sql: SELECT count() AS produk_di_bawah_reorder FROM efn_dwh.v_stock_below_reorder WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]]

cards.name: Produk mendekati kedaluwarsa (<= 7 hari)
cards.sql: SELECT expiry_status AS status, days_to_expiry AS sisa_hari, product_name AS produk, default_code AS kode, lot_name AS lot, expiration_date AS kedaluwarsa, company_name AS pt, warehouse_name AS gudang, location_name AS lokasi, quantity AS qty, stock_value AS nilai FROM efn_dwh.v_stock_expiring WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] ORDER BY sisa_hari, produk LIMIT 500

cards.name: Stok di bawah titik pesan ulang
cards.description: Pendekatan: stok on-hand per gudang (Odoo memakai stok perkiraan per lokasi).
cards.sql: SELECT product_name AS produk, default_code AS kode, company_name AS pt, warehouse_name AS gudang, on_hand AS stok, free_qty AS stok_bebas, min_qty AS minimum, max_qty AS maksimum, suggested_qty AS saran_pesan, trigger AS pemicu FROM efn_dwh.v_stock_below_reorder WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] ORDER BY produk LIMIT 500

cards.name: Nilai stok harian per gudang
cards.sql: SELECT day, warehouse_name AS gudang, sum(stock_value) AS nilai_stok FROM efn_dwh.v_stock_daily WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND day >= {{date_from}}]] [[AND day <= {{date_to}}]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] GROUP BY day, gudang ORDER BY day

cards.name: Stok saat ini per produk & gudang
cards.sql: SELECT warehouse_name AS gudang, product_name AS produk, default_code AS kode, category AS kategori, sum(quantity) AS qty, sum(free_quantity) AS qty_bebas, sum(stock_value) AS nilai, min(expiration_date) AS kedaluwarsa_terdekat FROM efn_dwh.v_stock_current WHERE 1 = 1 [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(company_name, {{company}}) > 0]] [[AND positionCaseInsensitive(warehouse_name, {{warehouse}}) > 0]] GROUP BY gudang, produk, kode, kategori ORDER BY nilai DESC LIMIT 500

cards.name: Kesegaran data ETL
cards.description: Heartbeat ETL (SEC-52). Data dianggap basi bila menit_sejak_sukses > 30.
cards.sql: SELECT job, last_ok_at AS sukses_terakhir_utc, minutes_since_ok AS menit_sejak_sukses, last_status AS status_terakhir, failures_24h AS gagal_24_jam FROM efn_dwh.v_etl_freshness WHERE job IN ('cycle', 'products', 'stock_snapshot') ORDER BY job
